g.text: Documentation: 5 clinician pairs • CDS: 10,000 alerts per group, seed 42
All data are simulated; these figures demonstrate the method and do not establish clinical efficacy or causation.
Panel B is descriptive. Panel C shows a Student t 95% CI; panel D shows Wilson 95% CIs for independent binomial groups.
